Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000996": As of 2026-02-24, the feature-flags service belongs to Team Cinder, which took it over from Team Boreal.  (about: Team Boreal, Team Cinder, feature-flags service)
- memory_id "1000876" [decision]: On 2025-12-17, Team Dune decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write.  (about: Team Dune, indexer)
- memory_id "1000802": Team Boreal holds its planning meeting on Thursdays.  (about: Team Boreal)
- memory_id "1000780" [constraint]: There is a deploy freeze on the billing service from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of peak season.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000777": Team Atlas runs its planning on Tuesdays.  (about: Team Atlas)
- memory_id "1000765" [constraint]: The scheduler deploys on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1000447": As of 2025-06-16, Team Boreal owns the catalog service, having taken it over from Team Dune.  (about: Team Boreal, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000445": As of 2025-06-16, dashboards and alerts for the catalog service are being repointed.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000371": On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal flagged that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, noting the catalog service is not their service.  (about: Team Boreal, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000367" [constraint]: The billing service only ships on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000338" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger)
- memory_id "1000307": The catalog service's joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000267": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000261" [constraint]: The catalog service only ships on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000250": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000237" [constraint]: The webhooks service only ships on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000204": Team Cinder holds planning on Mondays.  (about: Team Cinder)
- memory_id "1000189" [constraint]: The reporting service can be released on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000186" [constraint]: The event bus deploys on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: event bus)
- memory_id "1000147" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: auth gateway)
Existing entity names: Team Boreal, Team Cinder, feature-flags service, Team Dune, indexer, billing service, Team Atlas, scheduler, catalog service, ledger, webhooks service, reporting service, event bus, auth gateway
